name: io.github.batrapulkit/squidbrake
title: Squidbrake
description: Change control for AI agents: every MCP tool call on the record; risky ones wait for a person.

packageArguments.name: --app
packageArguments.description: Short name for the app being guarded, used in the dashboard and in rules (e.g. linear)

packageArguments.name: --url
packageArguments.description: The app's remote MCP server URL; every call to it is checked by Squidbrake first

environmentVariables.name: GATEWAY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Squidbrake gateway (start one with: pipx install squidbrake && squidbrake)

environmentVariables.name: GATEWAY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: An agent key from your gateway
